text.p: These are the leading stories in Botswana's independent weekly newspaper The Guardian on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Botswana Meat Commission has retrenched 600 workers from its Maun, Francistown and Lobatse abattoirs.
- The Directorate of Corruption and Economic Crime has issued a warrant for the arrest of a former general manager of Air Botswana, allegedly involved in corrupt practices.
- Botswana has "tentatively" agreed that the South African Truth and Reconcilitation Commission could sit in Botswana.
